title: Double Ender Chest
description: Adds REAL double ender chests with custom textures and separate storage container.
body:
Double Ender Chest can be placed anywhere at any time!

To create double ender chest place another one near single ender chest!

In fact, double ender chest have 54 slots of storage as A SEPARATE CONTAINER. That means single ender chest storage doesn't bother double one.
